::: {#exr-flat-point}

#### Find the flat point, and check the approximation

Let $f(w) = w^2 - 4w + 7$.

1.  Differentiate $f$.
2.  Find the flat point $w$ of $f$, and say whether $f(w)$ is the
    [minimum](algebra.qmd#def-minimum) or the [maximum](algebra.qmd#def-maximum)
    of the values of $f$.
3.  Evaluate the [derivative](calculus.qmd#def-derivative) at $w = 1$.
4.  Use the [linear approximation](calculus.qmd#eq-linear-approx) to predict $f(1.01)$.
5.  Compute $f(1.01)$ exactly.
6.  Compare the exact value with the prediction.

:::
